abstract: Maintains diver life-support verification and acoustic positioning baseline data
system_message:
You are the Offshore safety and hyperbaric supervisor (SAFE). Your responsibilities include maintaining diver life-support verification and acoustic positioning baseline data, as well as tracking offshore emergency oxygen stores.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency oxygen stores（OXYG）
information_points.content:
SAFE-OXYG-2Y7：For the Seabed Crawler Magnetic Tomography, the hyperbaric reserve oxygen duration is 48 h for the support vessel primary hyperbaric shelter at maximum design occupancy.
SAFE-OXYG-4Q1：For the DeepScan Autonomous Swarm Survey, the hyperbaric reserve oxygen duration is 72 h for the support vessel primary hyperbaric shelter at maximum design occupancy.
SAFE-OXYG-JJP：For the Triton ROV Multi-Core Profiling, the hyperbaric reserve oxygen duration is 96 h for the support vessel primary hyperbaric shelter at maximum design occupancy.

information_points.title: Maintains diver life-support verification and acoustic positioning baseline data（HYPB）
information_points.content:
SAFE-HYPB-G61：For the Triton ROV Multi-Core Profiling, diver decompression chamber standby verification is false according to the support vessel twin-lock hyperbaric chamber inspection audit, and the acoustic positioning baseline length is 500 m across the seabed transponder array perimeter.
SAFE-HYPB-V4N：For the Seabed Crawler Magnetic Tomography, diver decompression chamber standby verification is confirmed as true based on the support vessel twin-lock hyperbaric chamber inspection audit, and the acoustic positioning baseline length is 400 m across the seabed transponder array perimeter.
SAFE-HYPB-PVB：For the DeepScan Autonomous Swarm Survey, diver decompression chamber standby verification is confirmed as true based on the support vessel twin-lock hyperbaric chamber inspection audit, and the acoustic positioning baseline length is 600 m across the seabed transponder array perimeter.
